cuts.ofreeRecent: a Han-era inn — holds her keepsake at chest height; an indoor lap pool with lane ropes — swimming breaststroke; a quiet seaside tide pool bordered by smooth volcanic rock — catching a small white sunhat that has floated within reach after a light breeze; a sheltered picnic pavilion beside an ancient hillside plum orchard in clear spring daylight — laughing quietly after folding her plain white lunch napkin into a small bird; a night river covered with floating paper lanterns — holds her keepsake at chest height; her living room with a deep sofa — standing; her private chamber in a Han-era residence — standing; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; the inside of a quiet subway car — sips a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw through the straw; a narrow path through a tall bamboo grove — lying on her front; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a Three Kingdoms festival street — standing; a small repair kiosk with a cluttered workbench — adjusts a small mechanism on the work surface with a small screwdriver
